# ConsciousIntegration

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process by which distributed neural and bodily signals are bound into a unified, coherent experience or state, enabled by critical-state dynamics. Offers a target functional capability for neuromorphic systems aiming to emulate higher-order cognition and self-awareness in network-centric computing.
